note: Figures are affected by the size of the population in a country.
title: Number of people aged 70 and older with schizophrenia
subtitle: Estimated number of people aged 70 and older who have [schizophrenia](#dod:schizophrenia), whether or not they are diagnosed, based on representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. Prevalence is measured as the number experiencing schizophrenia at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.
